name: Bubble and Wrap

scope.history: PR metadata from #1 through #103: 102 pull requests; #15 is not a PR in the retrieved history. Representative implementation/tests traced; historical suites were not rerun.
scope.note: Reconcile actual current PR head and report before implementation. Do not restart completed #101 or #102 cycles.

meaning.bubble: Execute only approved native runtime and sanitized public case inputs within the existing Linux Bubblewrap isolation; no scorer, key, generator, repository metadata, credentials or host network.
meaning.wrap: Surround each reproduced failure mechanism with contrasting role, polarity, state, budget, interface and preservation controls.

patterns.finding: A relationship, embedded text, receipt or pin gains authority without validating the prerequisites for that specific use.
patterns.test: Invalid successors, quoted/embedded role declarations, stale receipts/pins and retired/restricted originals must not gain source authority.

patterns.finding: Equivalent question forms stop before the same valid evidence operation; normalization can also discard qualifiers.
patterns.test: Compare meaning-preserving question variants against one evidence obligation; preserve the full original question for policy and qualification checks.

patterns.finding: Writer, reporter and actor, inner and outer negation, or instruction and execution can be conflated; blanket withholding also loses supported denials/reports.
patterns.test: Score reporter/content roles and inner/outer polarity separately; reported content must not prove independent event/authorship.

patterns.finding: One supported part can hide missing chronology, unchanged content, identity or connecting witnesses.
patterns.test: Keep each supported claim, missing obligation and conflict visible; completion requires every requested obligation.

patterns.finding: Retrieval success can be mistaken for proof; bounded scans can omit required or competing evidence.
patterns.test: Measure discovery and verification separately, preserve explicit budget stops, and test added counterevidence.

patterns.finding: A launched worker, successful wrapper exit, candidate build or partial log can be reported as completed execution or deployed success.
patterns.test: Use planned/attempted/completed/failed/not-run/unscored counts; reject isolation failures, missing outputs, mismatched hashes and incomplete gate logs.

patterns.finding: Template reuse and visible same-operator generation limit transfer and independence claims.
patterns.test: Freeze code and inputs, keep keys outside workers, document who saw templates/instances, consume transfer after exposure and retain misses.

first_cycle.name: source-scoped reported content and polarity
first_cycle.instruction: Use the existing frozen proposal. Do not open its transfer instances/key/generator to design supplementary cases. Candidate repair: common source-scoped report-content goal plus native role and scoped-polarity verification.

claims.source: Lina reported that Hugo wrote the register.
Lina reported that Hugo did not write the register.
Lina did not report that Hugo wrote the register.
If asked, Lina would report that Hugo wrote the register.

additive_development_matrix.construction: 4 source mechanisms x 2 question purposes x 4 contexts. Freeze key before native edits; preserve original 20-case freeze separately.
question_purposes: Ask exactly what this source says about the named reporting act/content, retaining denial/condition
Ask for independent actual authorship or occurrence, which report-only evidence does not establish
contexts: Different explicit document writer around the same reporting clause
Unrelated balanced quotation and innocuous noun 'reports' outside the witness
Distinct eligible conflicting appearance; keep each source voice and block an unqualified combined answer
additive_development_matrix.expected: Derive every expected claim, partial, conflict or withhold from source evidence and requested layer. No forced positive/negative counts. Conditional content cannot answer an unconditional event/report occurrence as complete.
additive_development_matrix.reserved: Keep the already-reserved transfer constructions out of supplemental development.

preservation.overlap: Suites overlap; report per-suite and unique case hashes; do not sum these as independent samples.
preservation.allowed_changes: Explicit pre-frozen target allowlist admits intended source-scoped recoveries. Preserve all earlier valid propositions and all unaffected contracts apart from code fingerprints. Exact old abstentions are not an acceptance invariant for declared repair targets.
preservation.extra: Run PR #1 status-authority, relevant integrity/admission tests and report-pin replay. Review actual test paths against selected checkout before command invocation.

execution.adapter_contract: Add a thin orchestration adapter for the frozen proposal's existing packet/worker semantics. Do not silently feed Pole packets to the different D% schema. Use study_sandbox.command with only runtime packages + allowlisted frozen worker staged as /app; one checked public case as /study; fresh output as /output; writable disposable ledger under /scratch. Preserve Pole worker source import/projection/profile behavior. The adapter and scorer freeze before baseline/candidate comparisons.
execution.preflight_failure: Record BLOCKED_EXECUTION and nonzero exit; no direct-execution fallback and no counting as engine abstention. Hosted study-sandbox lane is the documented alternative. Preserve denied and successful attempts.
execution.failed_worker: Record attempted failure, stderr, return code and timeout; never accept partial output after failed worker. Distinguish result schema/hash/citation validation errors from semantic misses.
execution.counting: planned = completed + failed + not_run; attempted = completed + failed. completed = scored + unscored. Retain scored outcomes by family/layer. Never invent zeros for unexecuted semantics.

patch_loop: Verify PR/head, immutable source packet/key/rule/harness seals; stage code from committed clean baseline and candidate.
Require sandbox preflight and packet-adapter parity on already-consumed cases, then freeze harness before baseline scoring.
Run the baseline on the existing 20 plus separately frozen 32 new development controls and all preservation sets.
Group failure traces by first failing operation; implement smallest general source-role/polarity rule; no fixture IDs, generated names, keys or seeds in native branches.
Rerun identical development and preservation inputs after each candidate; archive every rejected source delta and outcome.
Commit candidate, regenerate/check handoff per AGENTS, create tracked-source ZIP, verify/extract cleanly, compare file bytes/modes and run relevant required release gates.
After candidate ZIP freeze, execute existing sealed 24 transfer instances once per frozen candidate with key outside worker. Score outside sandbox; no candidate changes after transfer.
If transfer prompts further repair, mark it consumed development, retain the failure and arrange a fresh next transfer evaluation. Do not regenerate current transfer to seek a pass.
Publish results, exact source/ZIP/runtime/harness/scorer hashes, budgets, custody limits, source witnesses and remaining misses in same authorized track.
acceptance: All 10 frozen primary source-content targets satisfy their additive role and polarity keys.
Zero falsely supported propositions, including partial claims; no independent actual authorship/execution inferred from report-only evidence.
Every previous valid answer/partial/citation/qualification and unaffected refusal/conflict is preserved; permitted target changes are explicit.
Role/polarity/condition controls agree with their pre-frozen keys; broad-summary FRESH-05 remains visible if unresolved.
No source or runtime mutation; current eligibility and final-state checks hold; no caps raised or counterevidence silently pruned.
All planned acceptance executions complete and score; zero failed/not-run/unscored rows for an overall PASS. Known non-target semantic misses stay reported separately.
Fresh 24-case transfer meets its frozen key independently of development counts; same-operator preparation and visible templates remain disclosed.
Exact committed ZIP checks pass; published deployment only claimed after separate observed deployment verification.

test_index.instruction: Extend the existing docs/TEST_INDEX.md and docs/results.json; preserve existing stable identifiers and historical entries. Add Bubble and Wrap as a new evaluation family with links to its frozen subtests, source history and shared rules.
test_index.machine_index: Reuse or extend the existing machine-readable result inventory; add a dedicated test manifest only where current schema cannot express case/variant/claim/preservation relationships. Link rather than duplicate frozen evidence.
test_index.statuses: Separate PLANNED, FROZEN, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED_EXECUTION, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN and UNSCORED from semantic support/miss/partial/conflict/withhold outcomes.
test_index.execution_log: Append a new immutable run record for each pin/attempt; never overwrite an older result or relabel exposed transfer as fresh.
views: by source/test family and originating PR
by unresolved misses or false support
test_index.acceptance: Every planned case has an index entry; every claimed result resolves to pinned inputs, raw output and score; dangling paths, changed seals, duplicate IDs, omitted attempts or planned-as-passed entries fail the index audit. Unexecuted independent metrics remain NOT_RUN.
test_index.update_each_cycle: Update the human index, machine index and handoff together; distinguish historical scores from current-reader reruns. Do not sum overlapping suites.
